about: What make upgrade-test lets through when state from a published release meets this tree.

changes: a finding in one walkthrough directory, for the release the check upgrades from by default. An entry for any other release fails the run, as does one that no finding matches, so an entry goes once that release is no longer the one upgraded from.
not_covered: a resource type no walkthrough directory puts in state, so its upgrade is never tried. An entry for a type that is covered fails the run.
Every entry needs a reason. TESTING.md has the rest.

changes.reason: The first refresh after the upgrade reads each SSH user's new ssh_public_key_refs from the platform, where the previous release stored none. The plan is empty and nothing is sent.
